description.value: Stega Eatery is a daytime café on West Cordova Street in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood, focused on breakfast, brunch, sandwiches, and salads. It offers gluten-free baked goods including loaves and bagels available for pre-order, signalling a thoughtful approach to dietary needs. Its location near the downtown waterfront makes it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists on the seawall or passing through Gastown.
